targets.quality_label: Noether Paper 24 RA69 German footnote-counter repair candidate
targets.coverage: Paper 24, Eliminationstheorie und allgemeine Idealtheorie, Math. Ann. 90 (1923), printed p.229 opening/source PDF p.2. The package contains a German cumulative TeX/PDF/log candidate, RA68-to-RA69 diff, GDZ article source PDF, canvas/image inventories, 1000dpi inspection witness, fix/disposition CSVs, method note, README, and checksums.
targets.findings: The source starts ordinary Paper 24 footnotes at printed 1), 2), 3) on printed p.229. The cumulative TeX entered Paper 24 without resetting the LaTeX footnote counter, so ordinary footnotes inherited prior-paper numbering. RA69 inserts setcounter{footnote}{0} immediately before the Paper 24 section heading. No prose or mathematical content changed. XeLaTeX compiled successfully with a 432-page output.
targets.limitations: This is a targeted German source-apparatus/footnote-numbering repair candidate only. It is not full Paper 24 certification, not whole-corpus source closure, not a critical edition, and not propagated to non-German branches.
